caption: The drawing depicts two main objects on a plain background. The larger object resembles an asymmetrical, yellow fabric piece with jagged right edges and a pink ribbon attached along its left border. This fabric is decorated with five blue-green fan-shaped shells, each radiating fine white lines, arranged diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, interspersed with clusters of small, delicate, white and tan flowers and brownish branches. Above and to the right of the main fabric piece is a smaller, similarly yellow semi-circular piece adorned along the curved edge with a row of tiny blue and brown floral motifs and a pink ribbon trailing from the top. The background is off-white with no additional objects or features.
title: Collar (For Child)
